raw_definitions: Definisi : 4. a number of people attending an important person, pengiring, pembantu; 5. (mus) suit. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. set of rooms in hotel, suite; 2. matching set of furniture, set: a rattan dining-room ~, set rotan bilik makan; 3. set of items intended to be used together, set: the new bathroom ~ is a horrible colour!, set bilik mandi yg baru itu teruk warnanya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
